meta.scope: Peru batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from INEI catalogue top-down: institutional identity, ENAHO, monetary poverty, national accounts anchors, CPI, employment, and Banco Central de Reserva. Definition locked.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática
candidates.description: National statistical office of Peru. Produces the core official statistics (prices, household surveys, poverty, national accounts inputs, census, etc.) and coordinates the national statistical system.
referenced_by: All major INEI programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central de Reserva statistical publications that cite INEI sources
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Peruvian official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Hogares (ENAHO) / National Household Survey
candidates.description: Continuous household survey that is the official source for living conditions, monetary poverty, multidimensional poverty, income and expenditure, education and health access. National coverage with departmental disaggregation.
candidates.notes: Central social survey of Peru. Continuous since 2003 (earlier quarterly from 1995). Primary microdata source for poverty measurement and for a wide range of living-conditions indicators. Quarterly living-conditions reports and annual poverty results are the main public products.

candidates.title: Pobreza monetaria / Monetary poverty
candidates.description: Official income/expenditure-based poverty and extreme-poverty incidence. Calculated by comparing household per-capita expenditure (from ENAHO) with nationally defined poverty lines. Annual publication with urban/rural and departmental breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. 2025: monetary poverty 25.7% (down 1.9 pp from 27.6% in 2024); extreme poverty 4.7%. Urban–rural gap remains large (urban ~23.4%, rural ~35.5%). Series supervised by the Comisión Consultiva.

candidates.title: Líneas de pobreza total y extrema
candidates.description: Monetary values of the total and extreme poverty lines (per capita and for reference households), updated with price information and differentiated by geographic domain.
candidates.notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. 2025 total poverty line ~S/ 462 per person; extreme (basic food basket) ~S/ 260 per person.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services. National and major-city coverage.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco Central de Reserva and into the updating of poverty lines.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Peru
candidates.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Quarterly and annual releases.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. INEI is the primary compiler of the real-sector accounts.

candidates.title: Encuesta Permanente de Empleo Nacional (EPEN) / Permanent National Employment Survey
candidates.description: Continuous employment survey providing labour-force indicators (employment, unemployment, underemployment, informality) at national and major-domain levels.
candidates.notes: Primary high-frequency labour survey. Complements the longer-running ENAHO on labour-market dimensions and feeds the quarterly living-conditions reports.

candidates.title: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
candidates.publisher: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, and inflation analysis. Complements INEI’s real-sector and price statistics.
candidates.notes: In the Peruvian division of labour INEI leads national accounts, prices, household surveys and poverty; the BCR leads monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts inflation-targeting policy.

candidates.title: Censos Nacionales de Población y Vivienda / National Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline, sampling frames for household surveys, and small-area population estimates.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by ENAHO/EPEN design, poverty analysis and departmental statistical work.

candidates.title: Condiciones de Vida en el Perú (quarterly technical report)
candidates.description: Quarterly technical report synthesising ENAHO and EPEN results on living conditions, employment and related welfare indicators.
candidates.notes: Regular public synthesis product. Bridges the continuous survey data to a widely used quarterly narrative on welfare and the labour market.

proposed_edges.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from ENAHO household expenditure and income data.
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita expenditure with the official poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with price information derived from the IPC.
The quarterly living-conditions report synthesises ENAHO results.
The quarterly living-conditions report also draws on EPEN labour indicators.
ENAHO is a core continuous survey of INEI.
IPC is produced and disseminated by INEI.
National accounts are compiled by INEI.
